extensions.org.licoland.adapter.openclaw/purpose: The OpenClaw adapter: the Gateway ACP driver vocabulary and the vendor protocol that classifies one Gateway frame exactly once below the adapter port, plus the recorded-transcript replay arm an installed OpenClaw client resumes. The kernel owns no part of OpenClaw and depends on none of it.
extensions.org.licoland.adapter.openclaw/persistent: This package declares no conversion because it owns no persisted package data of its own: it writes no data home, no cache and no store. The Gateway conversation keys it binds belong to the installed OpenClaw Gateway, and the client's own conversation store remains the kernel's.
